headline: Executive order uses Section 232 national security trade law to address imports of processed critical minerals and products made from them.
what_it_does: This order concerns processed critical minerals and products made from them. It relies on Section 232, a federal trade law that lets the President act on imports found to threaten national security, such as by adding tariffs or other limits. Only the title was provided, so the order's specific steps, such as any investigation, deadlines, or tariffs, cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that import processed critical minerals or products made from them
who_it_affects.how: They could face new reviews or import actions under Section 232, depending on what the order directs.

who_it_affects.group: US mining and mineral processing companies
who_it_affects.how: The order focuses on the domestic supply of processed critical minerals, which is the market these companies work in.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 15, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the provided material.
